name: Moon Sweepers
author: Fabra
description: Unofficial CPU-only Moon Sweepers server adapter using Wine and Steam P2P relay. Runs the retail game or an online-fix patched game (including SpaceWar AppId 480). Requires user-supplied game files.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Shared join password. 8-128 printable ASCII characters. Never use your Steam password.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam application ID used by SteamAPI and the anonymous GameServer. Keep 5335510 for the normal Moon Sweepers game, or set 480 (SpaceWar) when clients use the online-fix crack.

variables.name: Steam Game ID
variables.description: Steam game ID used by SteamAPI. Normally the same as Steam App ID: 5335510 for the normal game, or 480 for SpaceWar with the online-fix crack.

variables.name: Allowed Player SteamID64s
variables.description: Optional additional allowlist: 1-15 distinct numeric player SteamID64s separated by commas. Leave empty to allow any licensed player with the password.

variables.name: Save Slot
variables.description: Moon Sweepers save slot, from 1 to 5.

variables.name: GameServer API Game Port
variables.description: Internal Steam GameServer API setting. Not a public Pterodactyl allocation; joining uses SteamID/P2P relay.

variables.name: GameServer API Query Port
variables.description: Internal Steam GameServer API setting; must differ from game port. Not a public allocation.

variables.name: ID API
variables.description: Host a small HTTP endpoint on the primary game port (TCP) exposing the changing server ID: http://SERVER_ADDRESS:GAME_PORT/ for full state JSON, /id for the plain-text server_steam_id, /health for uptime. 1 = on, 0 = off.

variables.name: Server Icon URL
variables.description: URL of a hosted 1:1 (square) icon image for this server. Exposed by the ID API: included in GET / as "icon" and GET /icon redirects to it. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Server Banner URL
variables.description: URL of a hosted 16:9 banner image for this server. Exposed by the ID API: included in GET / as "banner" and GET /banner redirects to it. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Server MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day for this server. Exposed by the ID API: included in GET / as "motd" and served as plain text on GET /motd. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Backup Retention
variables.description: Number of confirmed graceful-shutdown backups to retain (1-100).

variables.name: Tick Rate
variables.description: Ticks per second the server runs at while the world is quiet (10-240). The game does a fixed amount of work per tick, so this is also how fast robots, machines and dust syncing are served at rest.

variables.name: Catch-up Tick Rate
variables.description: Ticks per second the server may go up to while it has a cleaning backlog, e.g. from mods that add robots or machines (Tick Rate-240). Type perf in the console to see what it reaches.

variables.name: Network Debug Log
variables.description: 1 adds low-level Steam transport and packet lines to the console log. Leave 0 for the normal player join/leave log.

variables.name: Enable BepInEx Mods
variables.description: 1 loads BepInEx 6 plugins from /home/container/mods/plugins. The first start after enabling, and after each game update, spends about a minute preparing BepInEx for the game build.

variables.name: Game API URL
variables.description: Moon Sweepers API the server downloads the game from when game-source is empty. Needs Server Key too; leave either empty to upload the game yourself.

variables.name: Server Key
variables.description: The API's SERVER_KEY. Lets this server download the game from the Game API URL. Keep it secret.

variables.name: Modpack Token
variables.description: A modpack's token from the Moon Sweepers registry (e.g. K7QX3MP, or K7QX3MP@3 to stay on revision 3). On every start the server installs that pack's mods, and players' launchers download the same mods. Needs Enable BepInEx Mods, Game API URL and Server Key. Leave empty to manage mods yourself.

variables.name: Client Version
variables.description: The client module release players must have to join, e.g. v0.2.2 (from the client releases). Players' launchers install exactly this one and only allow Play with it. A modpack's own client version takes precedence. Leave empty to allow any client.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for timestamps, e.g. America/New_York or UTC.
